document.notes: BOX 2 IS THE MOST DANGEROUS FIGURE IN A PACKET. With several transferors it is EITHER this seller's allocated share OR the whole unallocated proceeds repeated on every co-owner's copy, and nothing on the form says which. The filer instructions (Rev. 4-2025) require an allocation to be requested, and then: 'If you do not receive any allocation or you receive conflicting allocations, report on each transferor's Form 1099-S the total unallocated gross proceeds.' The box 2 instruction itself admits both meanings: 'Both total gross proceeds and the allocated gross proceeds for a multiple transferor transaction (enter either one or the other).' DIVIDING BY THE NUMBER OF OWNERS IS WRONG: spouses holding as joint tenants, tenants by the entirety, tenants in common or community property are 'a single transferor' and only one 1099-S is required. Box 2 is also GROSS: 'Do not reduce gross proceeds by any expenses paid by the transferor' — which is why selling expenses need Form 8949 column (f) code E. Box 4 checked means the true proceeds exceed box 2.
